subject: Libra Crest
text: A chest containing the Libra Crest appears after Squidite is defeated in Wintry Cave.

evidence.quote:
After you defeat Squidite, a chest will appear where he once stood. 
Inside, is the Libra Crest! Take the crest, and you're ready to leave 
Wintry Cave.

subject: Desert Hag
text: Desert Hag enemies are weak against fire and use counter attacks.

evidence.quote:
This Battlefield contains only one type of enemy, but it's one you
haven't faced yet, the Desert Hag. Watch out for their counter attacks,
and remember, they are weak against fire, if you need to use magic.

subject: Battlefield
text: Clearing out 10 battles on the Battlefield to the west of Wintry Cave awards 600 GP.

evidence.quote:
Before you continue, 
though, you might want to do a little more training, on the Battlefield
to the west of Wintry Cave....By
clearing out 10 battles, you'll win 600 GP!

subject: Libra Temple
text: A treasure chest in the Libra Temple contains arrows.

evidence.quote:
Check the treasure chest, to pick up some arrows, then step onto the
crest in the middle of the room.

subject: Libra Temple
text: Stepping onto the crest in the middle of the room in Libra Temple transports you to the Life Temple.

evidence.quote:
step onto the
crest in the middle of the room. You'll be trasnported to the Life 
Temple

subject: Life Temple
text: Taking the southern exit of the Life Temple lets you stand outside and see where you are on the map.

evidence.quote:
take the
southern exit, to see where you are on the map.)

subject: Cloaked Man
text: Talking to the cloaked man through the top door of the Life Temple rewards a bag of Wakewater.

evidence.quote:
Head through the door on the top of
the room, to meet - again - that cloaked man.

Talk to him, and he'll give you that bag of what Wakewater is left,
and then leave.

subject: Life Temple
text: A chest in the Life Temple contains 3 potions.

evidence.quote:
Check the chest for 3 potions, and then step back on
the crest, to transport back to Libra temple.

subject: Aquaria
text: Using Wakewater on the leaf in Aquaria revives the leaf, but the town remains frozen.

evidence.quote:
When you enter the area, you'll automatically move to the center
platform, and use the Wakewater on a leaf. The leaf will revive, but the
town stays frozen.

subject: Falls Basin
text: Push the first ice block 9 spaces north, left to the wall, and 1 more space north to access the ice wall door.

evidence.quote:
Start, by pushing the ice block in front of you 9 sapces north, and then
left, until it reachs a wall. Push it one more space north, and then 
walk around it, and through a door, in the wall of ice.

subject: Falls Basin
text: Push the second ice block in the sequence 3 West, 1 North, 2 Left, 6 North, 10 Right.

evidence.quote:
push the second block
in this sequence: 3 West, 1 North, 2 Left, 6 North, 10 Right.

subject: Falls Basin
text: Move the first ice block in the sequence 1 East, 1 South, 8 East, 1 North, 3 East, 1 North.

evidence.quote:
Finally, go back
to the very first block, and move it in this sequence: 1 East, 1 South,
8 East, 1 North, 3 East, 1 North.

subject: Falls Basin
text: A chest inside the door in the ice wall contains bombs.

evidence.quote:
go through the door in the ice
wall. There's a chest containing some bombs, and a Lamia for you to 
fight.

subject: Falls Basin
text: A chest past the Snow Crab contains the Heal Spell.

evidence.quote:
Go around the Snow Crab, and get the
Heal Spell from the chest, and then go back to fight the crab.

subject: Snow Crab
text: Snow Crab has 3,000 HP, fights alongside two desert hags, and awards 234 EXP and 3 GP.

evidence.quote:
Snow Crab - HP 3,000...EXP: 234     | Battle Strategy: Snow Crab has two desert hags with  |
| GP: 3        | him, when you fight.

subject: Phoebe
text: Phoebe gives you the Jumbo Bombs after Snow Crab is defeated.

evidence.quote:
After you defeat the Snoe Crab, Phoebe will give you another item. The
Jumbo Bombs!

subject: Battlefield
text: The Battlefield in front of the Ice Pyramid features Lamia, Mage, and Desert Hag enemies and rewards 540 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield that's in front of it.)...Enemies - Lamia + Mage + Desert Hag
Reward - 540 EXP

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: Stabbing the statue on the right with your sword opens the entrance door to the Ice Pyramid.

evidence.quote:
Check the 
statue on the right, and Phoebe will tell you she sees a switch. Stab 
the statue with your sword, and the door will open.

subject: Magic Mirror
text: The Magic Mirror is found near the wall at the end of the path farthest to the right in the Ice Pyramid.

evidence.quote:
Take the path
farthest to the right; You'll fight a few enemies you can't see yet, but
near the wll, at the end of the path is the Magic Mirror. Now you can
see the enemies!

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: A chest along the path just left of the Magic Mirror path contains bombs.

evidence.quote:
Take the path just left of the one you
were on, to find a Desert Hag, and a chest of bombs.

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: Heading left and south from the Desert Hag near the entrance reveals two chests containing Refreshers and arrows.

evidence.quote:
This time, head left, and head south from where you see a Desert Hag.
There are two chests, one with Refreshers, and one with arrows here.

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: A chest in the room past the Phanquid contains Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Fight the Phanquid in the next room, to reach a chest
full of Heal Potions.

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: A chest behind a hidden door blocked by a Lamia on the next floor contains arrows.

evidence.quote:
There is a Lamia on the next floor, blocking a hidden
door. Head through it, to reach a chest with arrows inside.

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: Stabbing the statue on the left behind the stairs opens a door to a chest of arrows.

evidence.quote:
head around, behind where the
stairs are, and stab the statue on the left. A door will open, and let
you access a chest of arrows.

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: Defeating Freezer Crab enemies yields two treasure chests containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
You can defeat the Freezer Crab, to get a treasure
chest with arrows in it on the left, and another Crab, to the south. 
Defeat the second crab, and get more arrows from the chest

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: Two chests inside the door guarded by Stoney Roost contain bombs and arrows.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door, and fight the Stoeny Roost inside,and open the two
chests, to get bombs and arrows.

subject: Noble Armor
text: Falling into the blocked section rewards chests with Heal Potions, Arrows, Refreshers, Potions, and the Noble Armor, which increases defense by 12.

evidence.quote:
walk one step ahead, to fall down, into the
blocked section of this floor. You can fight, and get the chests, which
contain Heal Potions, Arrows, Refreshers, and Potions, as well as the 
valuable, Noble Armor! It increases your defense by 12!

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: Two chests past the Sphinx on the right contain 10 bombs inside each.

evidence.quote:
Defeat the Sphinx onb the right, and you can get two chests, each with
10 bombs inside.

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: A chest on the left of the room reached by jumping across platforms contains cure potions.

evidence.quote:
on the left of the room (get there by jumping 
acorss the platforms) is a chest of cure potions.

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: Blowing up the center tile of the middle platform with a bomb allows you to jump down to the first floor.

evidence.quote:
Move back to the middle platform, and blow up the center tile with a
bomb. Jump down the hole, and continue falling down, until you reach 
the first floor.

subject: Knight Sword
text: A fancy chest among the surrounded enemies on the lower floor contains the Knight Sword.

evidence.quote:
Stab one of the statues, to open the floor, and jump
down again. You'll be completely surrounded by enemies, and chests....The chests contain Arrows, Potions, Heal Potions, and most importantly,
in the fancy chest, the Knight Sword!

subject: Ice Pyramid
text: Hitting the statue on the right reveals two chests that both contain arrows.

evidence.quote:
You can hit the
statue on the right, to reveal two chests, both contain arrows. 
Drop off the platform in the next room to reach them.

subject: Ice Golem
text: Ice Golem has 6,500 HP, is weak against fire, and awards 246 EXP and 0 GP.

evidence.quote:
Ice Golem - 6,500HP...EXP: 246     | Battle Strategy: First of all, this guy, being made  |
| GP: 0        | of ice, is obviously going to be weak against fire.

subject: River Coin
text: A treasure chest after defeating the Ice Golem contains the River Coin.

evidence.quote:
Get the River
Coin from the treasure chest, and then, leave the Ice Pyramid

subject: Aquaria
text: Taking the stairs into the water and going underneath the house on the bottom-left enters Spencer's Place.

evidence.quote:
Take the stairs into the
water, and move to the house on the bottom-left side of the screen. From
the water, you can go underneath the house. Do so, to enter Spencer's
Place.

subject: Spencer
text: Spencer gives you the Venus Key and hints that you should go to Focus Tower and Fireburg.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the old man,
who happens to be Spencer. After some talking, he'll give you the Venus
Key, and hint you to go to Focus Tower, and ultimately, to Fireburg.

subject: Spencer's Place
text: Going through the door in Spencer's Place lets you reach a chest of potions.

evidence.quote: By the way, if you use the door, you can reach a chest of potions

subject: Aquaria Inn
text: Bombs and potions can be purchased in the Inn in Aquaria.

evidence.quote:
By the way, you can buy bombs and
potions in the Inn, though, you can get them for free at Libra Temple.

subject: Snow Crab
text: Have Hero use his bombs on all of them, while Phoebe uses Thunder on Snow Crab.

evidence.quote: Have Hero use his bombs on all...of them, while Phoebe uses Thunder, on Snow Crab
